 Print Travis Hunter’s wife Leanna Lenee makes surprising admission about her custom Jaguars outfit before Colts win Travis Hunter’s wife, Leanna Lenee, caught attention with her latest Jacksonville Jaguars game-day look, but wearing the outfit was not as comfortable as it appeared. Ahead of the Jaguars’ November 1 game against the Indianapolis Colts, Leanna put together a custom outfit inspired by the team’s new Rivalries uniforms. She later admitted on TikTok that the look “hurt like heck,” giving fans a glimpse of the effort behind her appearance. Leanna Lenee reveals why her Travis Hunter-inspired Jaguars outfit was uncomfortable
 Leanna shared an outfit-check video on TikTok, where a fan commented on her game-day look. Responding to the comment, she admitted, “It hurt like heck.” Although she did not explain which part of the outfit caused the discomfort, her video showed the details she had put together for the occasion. Her outfit included a customized, off-the-shoulder Jaguars jersey paired with loose-fitting, leather-style trousers and black heels. She also wore a belly chain with her husband Travis Hunter’s name hanging from it, adding a personal touch to the look. Her accessories included rings, glitter, carefully designed nails and a black handbag. Leanna also shared the fragrance combination she wore for the game. She mixed Valentino Strawberry and Vanilla with YSL Berry to create her own scent for the occasion. However, her preparations were not limited to her own appearance. She also made sure her son had an outfit that matched the family’s Jaguars theme. Since the team did not have the right size available for him, she put together a last-minute combination of a white, black and teal T-shirt, a black jumpsuit and Crocs. This was not Leanna’s first game-day outfit inspired by the Jaguars. During the team’s earlier game against the New England Patriots, she wore a dusty-blue fitted dress decorated with a Jaguars logo, a jaguar patch and a jersey-style number patch. The back also featured Hunter’s name. She completed that look with team-inspired jewellery, a silver Rolex watch and white cowboy boots. Her son joined her in a grey top with Jaguars patches, matching trousers and white shoes. Travis Hunter and Jacksonville Jaguars celebrate 42-7 win over Indianapolis Colts
 While Leanna was busy putting together her game-day look, Travis Hunter and the Jaguars had an important afternoon on the field. Jacksonville introduced its new Rivalries uniforms against the Colts on November 1 at EverBank Stadium, and the team made the occasion even better with a 42-7 win. The Jaguars had already built a 28-0 lead by halftime, leaving Indianapolis with plenty of work to do after the break. However, Jacksonville continued to control the game and added two more touchdowns in the second half. Hunter had a limited role on offense. He recorded one rushing attempt for five yards and was targeted once but did not make a catch. His defensive numbers were better, as he finished with four tackles, including three solo tackles and one assisted tackle, according to NFL.com. Meanwhile, Trevor Lawrence played a major role in Jacksonville’s win. He completed 10 of 14 passes for 210 yards and three touchdowns without throwing an interception. Running back Bhayshul Tuten also had a strong afternoon, finishing with 104 rushing yards and a touchdown on 16 carries. He added two catches for 55 yards and another touchdown. Join conversation

 Jacksonville’s defense also made life difficult for the Colts, forcing three turnovers during the game. The result gave the Jaguars another important divisional win. For Leanna, the afternoon was also an opportunity to support her husband and his team through a carefully planned family look. Although she admitted that her outfit was painful to wear, she still gave fans a closer look at the work that went into getting ready for the game.
